p: spake all these words: When Moses and Aaron were gone up, or had passed the bounds of the people, God spoke thus out of the mount Horeb, that all the people heard.
before me: To whose eyes all things are open.
bow down thyself to them: By this outward gesture, all forms of service and worship to idols is forbidden.
jealous God: And will have revenge on those who condemn my honour.
thousands of them that love me: So ready is he rather to show mercy than to punish.
vain: Either by swearing falsely or rashly by his Name, or by condemning it.
to keep it holy: Which is by meditating the spiritual rest, by hearing God's word, and resting from worldly labours.
father and thy mother: By parents it is also meant all that have authority over us.
kill: But love and preserve your brother's life.
commit adultery: But be pure in heart, word and deed.
steal: But study to save his goods.
witness against thy neighbour: But further his good name, and speak truth.
covet thy neighbour's house: You may not so much as wish his hinderance in anything.
prove you: Whether you will obey his precepts as you promised in Ex 19:8.
nakedness be not discovered thereon: Which might be by his stooping or flying up of his clothes.
